headline: Vale Reports Strong Third-Quarter Cash Generation on Copper Strength
summary: Vale posted third-quarter results showing that strong copper performance helped offset higher costs in its iron ore and nickel divisions, driving solid cash generation and pushing shares higher.
why: Vale is one of the world's largest mining companies and a major global producer of iron ore and base metals, serving as a key indicator for the commodities sector and emerging market equities.

impacts.name: Vale SA
impacts.why: Strong cash generation and robust copper results offset operational cost pressures in iron ore and nickel.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors responded positively to stronger-than-expected cash generation and robust base metal contributions that cushioned margin pressures in the core iron ore business.
